entities.name: Donal
entities.description: A Neurok human on Mirrodin, father of Bruenna, who led an insurrection at Medev.

entities.name: Bruenna
entities.description: Donal's daughter who held a grudge against Pontifex and the Synod.

entities.name: Pool of Knowledge
entities.description: Where Donal concluded the Vedalken were evil.

events.summary: Donal was employed by Pontifex after improving serum processing machines.
events.quote: He was employed by the vedalken Pontifex after he improved serum processing machines

events.summary: Immersed in the Pool of Knowledge, Donal concluded the Vedalken were evil.
events.quote: he had the epiphany that the Vedalken were evil

events.summary: Donal led an insurrection at Medev.
events.quote: he led an insurrection at Medev

events.summary: The Synod had Donal killed, and Bruenna held a grudge.
events.quote: the Synod had him killed and led Bruenna to hold a grudge against both Pontifex and the Synod
